message:
I have a friend who turns into a tornado of panic whenever the weather forecast mentions a storm. Last winter, when we were expecting a big snow, she texted me at least five times asking if I thought we needed to build an ark. I reminded her that we live in a landlocked state and that a snow shovel was really all we needed. 

We ended up having a cozy evening, sipping hot cocoa, and watching the snow pile up. It reminded me that staying calm is half the battle. 

A little preparation goes a long way, but so does a cup of cocoa and a good laugh. What’s your go-to tip for weathering the storm?
